INSERT INTO "properties_property" ("source", "external_id", "title", "description", "transaction", "price", "bedrooms", "bathrooms", "parking_spaces", "area_m2", "address", "neighborhood", "city", "state", "is_active", "created_at", "updated_at") VALUES ('NEXO', 'NX-2', 'Studio Centro', '', 'RENT', 2500.00, 1, 0, 0, NULL, 'Av Paulista, 1000', '', 'Sao Paulo', 'SP', true, '2026-10-26 15:02:12.293911+00:00'::timestamptz, '2026-10-26 15:02:12.293915+00:00'::timestamptz) RETURNING "properties_property"."id"

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__count" FROM "properties_property" WHERE ("properties_property"."is_active" AND "properties_property"."city" = 'Belo Horizonte' AND "properties_property"."transaction" = 'SALE' AND "properties_property"."price" <= 550000 AND "properties_property"."bedrooms" >= 2)

SELECT "properties_property"."id", "properties_property"."source", "properties_property"."external_id", "properties_property"."title", "properties_property"."description", "properties_property"."transaction", "properties_property"."price", "properties_property"."bedrooms", "properties_property"."bathrooms", "properties_property"."parking_spaces", "properties_property"."area_m2", "properties_property"."address", "properties_property"."neighborhood", "properties_property"."city", "properties_property"."state", "properties_property"."is_active", "properties_property"."created_at", "properties_property"."updated_at" FROM "properties_property" WHERE ("properties_property"."is_active" AND "properties_property"."city" = 'Belo Horizonte' AND "properties_property"."transaction" = 'SALE' AND "properties_property"."price" <= 550000 AND "properties_property"."bedrooms" >= 2) ORDER BY "properties_property"."updated_at" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "properties_propertyphoto"."id", "properties_propertyphoto"."property_id", "properties_propertyphoto"."url", "properties_propertyphoto"."position" FROM "properties_propertyphoto" WHERE "properties_propertyphoto"."property_id" = 365 ORDER BY "properties_propertyphoto"."position" ASC
